# Prepadmit

> Prepadmit is the leading preparation platform for the Bocconi Admission Test. It provides 5 official past exams, unlimited practice in real test conditions, detailed corrections with step-by-step explanations, and a personal progress tracker with global ranking to maximize Bocconi admission chances.

Prepadmit helps students preparing for the Bocconi University admission test (BAT), a decisive exam where over 20,000 candidates apply each year and fewer than 10% are admitted. The test accounts for 55% of the application weight. The platform combines authentic past exam materials, on-demand generated tests, topic-based practice, immediate corrections, and performance analytics with peer benchmarking. Designed by HEC and Bocconi graduates, Prepadmit reports an average score improvement of +34% and offers a 48-hour money-back guarantee. The platform is accessible on PC and mobile.
